data_fields.name: death_xp_loss_formula
data_fields.donor_constant: floor(level * (level / 18.0) * 12000); zero if killer is client or bot

data_fields.name: pvp_loot_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: reward 0 none, 1 take one, 2 take all, 3 one defined item

best_idea: A death resolves in one server step: the killer tier decides XP loss and the rez window, a player corpse gives the killer one item (take-one) and closes itself after that take, and the rez clock runs only while the owner is online.
decision_why: The tiering by killer kind and the take-one close are what Frankendom's take-one loot and open PvP flag need; the donor's 3 h and 10 min windows and per-level XP formula are numbers to make data, and the Frankendom rulings do not yet say whether death costs XP, so the shape is kept and the numbers are set per zone.
acceptance: A server test kills a player in an open PvP zone: the corpse holds the items, the killer can take exactly one top-level item, a second take by the killer is refused, and the victim's XP is unchanged (client killer) while an NPC kill follows the level formula.
